==Usage==
<pre><nowiki>{{Film|number}}</nowiki></pre>
Where {{Para|number}} is either a Roman numeral I-IX or a number 1-9. There is no difference between using a Roman numeral such as IV or its Arabic numeral equivalent 4.

:→<small>See [[Forum:CT:Use of the Film Template]]</small>

==Examples==
{|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} style="word-break:break-word"
!Code !! Result
|-
|<pre><nowiki>{{Film|I}}</nowiki></pre>||{{Film|I}}
|-
|<pre><nowiki>{{Film|II}}</nowiki></pre>||{{Film|II}}
|-
|<pre><nowiki>{{Film|6}}</nowiki></pre>||{{Film|6}}
|}
